text:
Evelyn Park: Hi team — quick Q: I	m due in August and will be traveling to my home country for 6 weeks right after birth (childcare + family support). I	m on an H1-B and want to make sure taking leave abroad doesn	 interrupt visa status or payroll. Also need guidance on backfill while I	m out.

Sam (People Ops): Congrats Evelyn! :tada: Short answers: payroll/top-up still applies if you file leave and keep benefits; visa travel during leave is possible but depends on timing and consulate appointments. We	ll coordinate with immigration counsel. Can you DM your planned travel dates?

Evelyn Park: DM sent. Dates: Aug 12 - Sep 25 (6 weeks).

Michelle (People Ops): Two operational points: 1) File the parental leave in the HR portal and choose "International travel during leave" option so we flag immigration. 2) If you	re out of country for >30 days, benefits continuation needs manual confirmation — we	ll handle that on our side. Please upload any appointment confirmations.

HR-Int-Bot: Immigration check queued. Ticket #INT-4521. Expected review 2 business days. Link: https://internal-hr/tickets/INT-4521

Tom Becker: Hi Evelyn — for backfill: manager approved 12-week contractor starting Aug 1 to overlap the handoff. Budget will go through the emergency backfill pool per policy. Need job summary + top 5 responsibilities so we can post.

Evelyn Park: Will draft job summary tonight. Quick ask: can the contractor be US-based? I	m worried about access to staging keys if they	re remote.

Sam (People Ops): US-based contractor is fine. For access: IT will provision scoped service account and VPN token; no personal credentials should be shared. IT-Support will own onboarding and CI token rotation.

IT-Support: Noted. We	ll create a short-lived service account with read-only prod-view and oncall escalation rights. Contractor network restrictions (country-based) can be applied. Please submit onboarding form 2 weeks before start.

Evelyn Park: On the payroll/top-up — if I	m paid via Redwood top-up while abroad, will tax withholding change? I	m concerned about double taxation with home country.

Michelle (People Ops): Good question. Payroll withholding remains US-based unless your home-country tax residency rules trigger a requirement. Sam, can payroll run a quick estimate for withholding implications?

Sam (People Ops): Will run estimate and coordinate with payroll/benefits vendor. Note: if you become a tax resident in the other country during the leave, you may have additional filing obligations. We	ll flag this to immigration counsel and payroll.

HR-Int-Bot: Immigration note: If travel intersects with visa stamping or travel ban windows, counsel may advise delaying travel. Counsel response ETA 48h.

Tom Becker: On performance cycle: manager suggests pausing calibration for the review period. We	ll mark "leave-exempt" in calibration docs to preserve promotion eligibility. Evelyn ok with that?

Evelyn Park: Yes please pause. Thanks.

Michelle (People Ops): Checklist for Evelyn:
- By June 10: Submit leave request and attach expected travel itinerary
- By June 12: Immigration counsel check complete (ticket INT-4521)
- By June 15: Payroll withholding estimate provided
- By July 1: Backfill JD posted + contractor interviews scheduled
- Aug 1: Contractor start + 2-week shadow

Evelyn Park: Thanks everyone. One more: laptop return — I	m being asked to return my work laptop before travel for customs reasons. Can I request retention while on leave?

Sam (People Ops): We usually ask devices back for long international travel due to asset tracking. Exception possible for medical-family reasons. Upload a note in the IT retention form and copy me. If retention denied, we	ll escrow a minimal device for emergencies.

IT-Support: If retention approved, we'll set up MDM policy for location restriction and remote wipe in case of loss. Also can pre-install VPN + limited admin.

Evelyn Park: Appreciate the clarity. I	ll upload forms today.

HR-Int-Bot: Auto-reminder scheduled: submit documentation by June 10.

Tom Becker: I	ll draft the contractor JD and post to hiring board by Friday. Tagging @Evelyn for review before posting.

Evelyn Park: Will review tonight. Thanks team :heart:
